about: Curated wildcard prompts. Edit freely — no code changes needed. Only entries with "status": "approved" enter the daily rotation (and only if they have at least 12 resolvable answers). Use official English names; spelling variants accepted by the game work too. Run `npm run wildcards` to check names, counts and statuses. 'basis' is 'visual' for subjective appearance-based prompts (judged from official artwork, NOT the Pokédex color) or 'concept' for what a design is based on.

prompts.prompt: Name a Pokémon with more than one head.
prompts.description: Two or more heads or faces, including Pokémon made of several linked bodies (curated list).
prompts.reviewNotes: Borderline, deliberately included: Girafarig/Farigiraf (tail head), Hydreigon (hand heads), Barbaracle (hand faces), Klink line (faces on gears), Falinks (six troopers). Deliberately excluded: Magnezone (one face), Koffing/Diglett/Deino/Wiglett (one head).

prompts.prompt: Name a Pokémon that looks like a man-made object.
prompts.description: Designs based on manufactured things — tools, furniture, food, machines (curated list).
prompts.reviewNotes: Includes food items (Vanillite line, Sinistea/Poltchageist lines). Excluded natural objects (Sudowoodo, Bonsly, Applin, Pumpkaboo), costumes (Mimikyu) and digital beings (Porygon line). Check Carkol (mine cart), Banette (doll) and Kartana (origami).

prompts.prompt: Name a Pokémon based on a dog or a wolf.
prompts.description: Domestic dogs, wolves and jackals — foxes and other canines don't count (curated list).
prompts.reviewNotes: Riolu/Lucario are jackal-inspired; Smeargle is a beagle; Electrike/Manectric are commonly described as dog/wolf-like. Foxes (Vulpix, Zorua, Nickit lines) intentionally excluded.

prompts.prompt: Name a Pokémon based on a cat.
prompts.description: Any feline — house cats, lions, lynxes and tigers (curated list).
prompts.reviewNotes: Mew and Zeraora are described as feline in official material — confirm. Excluded: Entei (often called lion/dog), Absol, Espeon (not officially feline).

prompts.prompt: Name a Pokémon with a visible shell.
prompts.description: A shell (or shell-like carapace) on its body in official artwork (curated list).
prompts.reviewNotes: Escavalier wears Shelmet's shell; Dwebble/Crustle carry rock 'shells'. Excluded: Kabutops (shell not prominent), Oshawott (scalchop is held), Shellos/Gastrodon (no shell). Galarian Slowbro also has Shellder.
